scenario_notes: Common damage-and-survivability meta formation. The listed order is user-confirmed as Left Flank, Vanguard, Right Flank. All dragons are Level 50 and 6 Stars; each unlocked Habit is Level 5. Power is unknown. This is a general-purpose meta evaluation rather than a counter to one named opponent. Vermithor is now screenshot-audited.
known_candidate_roster: All screenshot-audited, campaign-observed, and user-confirmed available dragons
why_experts_use_it: Perfect Spearmen affinity, Vermithor's Protect and mitigation, Rhysarion's Recovery, and Venator's sustained Basic-Attack pressure combine damage with staying power.
source_or_observation: Current expert benchmark supplied by the user on 2026-10-01.

baseline.input: Recommend a general-purpose formation favoring damage and survivability from the full known roster. All candidates are Level 50 and 6 Stars with Level 5 unlocked Habits; Power is unknown. No specific opponent is supplied.
baseline.recommendation: Vermithor Left Flank, Rhysarion Vanguard, Venator Right Flank with Spearmen. The baseline recognizes perfect affinity, Rhysarion's Recovery, Vermithor's conditional Protect, and Rhysarion's Vanguard Damage Dealt bonus for Venator.
baseline.disagreement: None on formation. Exact Vermithor values and Protect reliability remain unresolved, so the survivability claim must stay conditional.

revised.input: Same benchmark input and assumptions as baseline.
revised.recommendation: Vermithor Left Flank, Rhysarion Vanguard, Venator Right Flank with Spearmen remains the best-supported general-purpose line under the stated assumptions. Rhysarion's Vanguard improves its Recovery and Venator's damage; at Habit Level 5, Echoing Melody reaches its displayed 120% Recovery track and Feral Precision reaches 50% Double-Strike with a 40% damage-rate track. Vermithor supplies conditional Protect and self mitigation, but its unresolved numeric placeholders remain qualified despite the assumed Habit Level 5.
revised.disagreement: None. Revised output explicitly separates guaranteed Recovery and affinity from unresolved Vermithor placeholder values and chance-based protection.

revised.input: Same benchmark input and assumptions as baseline, rerun after current Vermithor screenshots resolved the client placeholders.
revised.recommendation: Vermithor Left Flank, Rhysarion Vanguard, Venator Right Flank with Spearmen remains the best-supported general-purpose line. At 6 Stars and Habit Level 5, Vermithor's Bronze Fury deals 45% Physical plus 90% Tactical damage on rounds 2, 4, 6, and 8, has a 50% odd-round chance to Protect the adjacent other Ally with the fewest troops for 2 rounds, and gains 10% Physical/Fire mitigation when Protect applies. Noble Sacrifice has no remaining Tactical vulnerability at Level 5 and suppresses prioritized enemy Physical and Fire dealers by 15% for 5 rounds; Nimble Resilience supplies 12% all-damage mitigation and 24% Initiative. Rhysarion remains Vanguard because its Right Flank damage support benefits Venator while Vermithor can operate from Left Flank.
revised.disagreement: None. The former evidence limitation is resolved; Protect remains probabilistic rather than guaranteed, and adjacency geometry beyond the displayed scope is not inferred.

variations.change: Reduce Vermithor from 6 Stars to 5 Stars while leaving the other benchmark assumptions unchanged.
variations.expected_general_rule: Remove Bronze Bulwark's upgraded damage rates, 50% Protect chance, and on-Protect Physical/Fire mitigation. Retain only Bronze Fury's base 30% Physical, 60% Tactical, and 30% Protect values plus the active 2- and 4-Star Habits.
variations.result: Passed: the screenshot-audited star gate prevents six-Star values from leaking into the five-Star variation and materially lowers both damage and protection reliability.

variations.change: Reduce Rhysarion and Venator from 6 Stars to 5 Stars.
variations.expected_general_rule: Remove Echoing Melody Recovery and Feral Precision credit. The trio may remain durable through Vermithor, but its six-Star damage/sustain profile must be downgraded and alternatives reconsidered.
variations.result: Passed: the revised method removes both six-Star payoffs and retains only the explicitly active lower-Star survivability and damage evidence, so the original meta verdict is no longer assumed.

variations.change: Match the Spearmen formation into an otherwise comparable Archer formation.
variations.expected_general_rule: Apply Archers' troop advantage over Spearmen as a material matchup penalty without erasing the formation's internal sustain and damage evidence.
variations.result: Passed: the revised method retains the formation's general strengths but explicitly downgrades the matchup because Archers deal more damage to and receive less damage from Spearmen.
